lines: Hebiko, with her powerful tentacle sensors, and our friends who had been on their part-time jobs, plus the Great Witch and I, had cornered the Snowfiend.
◇Ugh... screw you! Bringing a crowd of women with you! Explode! Evaporate!◇
Huh!? Don't say something that could cause a misunderstanding! A-And there's a male dog over there!
Forget that, the evil spirit is about to get away! Dahru Masanga Koron'd!
As Lilith murmured the incantation, the evil spirit, who had tried to run away, fell flat on his face.
We won't let you escape, you vengeful spirit!
Rinko's blade hummed, and Mari's earth power-clad fists came after the snowman.
I'll turn you into chunks of snow.
No, let's smash him to bits and make him into fine, powdery snow!
◇Stop! I'm sorry!! Forgive me please! I'll do anything!!◇
◇...is what you thought I'd say?! Eat thiiiiis!!!!! Fwooooooo...◇
The moment the evil spirit opened his mouth wide, a cold, gray blizzard began to blow.
Surprised by the sudden attack, we were completely swallowed by the snowstorm.
F... Fuma-chan, for some reason... everything feels so lonely!
It was a sadness akin to despair. As if you were left all alone in the gray wilderness, just able to hear the boisterous laughter of a distant city.
◇Ha... hahaha! Let it consume you all! My cold breath!◇
◇I will awaken your envy and your inferiority complexes! I won't tolerate being the only one who is unhappy!◇
Shit...! That thing is twisted to the core! Hebiko! Don't let it take you! ...Hebiko?
The girl who turns into an octopus, no matter how brilliant and cute she is, is still a freak...
Crap, she's going straight off the deep end! ...Ugh...
I also felt something heavy pressing on my chest.
("Diot," "Worthless Head of the Clan." That's right, no one expects anything of me. Gaiza is proof of thatー)
(No, I can't get caught up in this. This is his attack. I need to keep coolー)
At that moment. A soft curtain of light enveloped the area.
The light was expanding from Lilith who had been mumbling something in the corner for a while.
Lilith... were you casting a spell this whole time!?
Lilith's spell had finally worked after numerous failures.
Her powerful magic had manifested as the tenderness of Christmas and surrounded the area, warming our hearts little by little.
It even warmed the snowman's heart, so beholden by resentmentー
◇Wh... what is this?!! My body... my body is meltiiiing!!!◇
Now that the snowman had lost its motivating force, it could no longer keep its form.
Hebiko can hear other voices coming from snowman-chan!
◆I was always home alone at Christmas, but I looked forward to my father buying me candy...◆
◆I got dumped on Christmas, but my friends got together on New Year's and comforted me... I was thankful for friendship...◆
Here and there, tiny lights like fireflies floated up from the snowman's body and then slowly disappeared.
Are the resentments reclaiming their happy memories and becoming purified...?
◇Damn it, damn it! You Christmas cretins!! Mark my words, next year, next year for sure I'll...!◇
The evil spirit got thinner and thinner before our eyes, and finally dissipated into the sky when it could no longer sustain its form.
And suddenly, the air turned cold and snow began to flutter down.
Snow! All the snow that he kept for himself is falling again!
Phew, that's taken care of. Looks like work is going to get busy again! Shinohara, let's hurry back!
Yes, Rinko-senpai! Thank you, Ms. Witch. Fuma-kun, Hebiko-chan, see you!
With that, Rinko and Mari returned to their part-time job.
First snow of the year! Isn't this romantic, Fuma-chan?
Yeah... but isn't the snow getting stronger and stronger?
Even as we were speaking, the snowfall got heavierー
The light snowfall quickly turned into a raging blizzard and totally covered the city.
This is great! Winter has properly returned and I think I've come one step closer to becoming a full-fledged Great Witch. Thank you, octopus archdemon and her companion!
Hebiko already told you she's not a demon...
It seemed that there was still some kind of misunderstanding, but Lilith the witch politely bowed her head in thanks.
We can ride a sleigh with all this snow! Loojh Bahbs Ledd!!!
Lilith summoned a sleigh and hopped on with glee.
Before Berylic could stop her, the sleigh Lilith had hopped on was flung into the air by the force of the snowstorm.
Berylic disappeared into the snow in pursuit of Lilith.
The legendary Great Witch... or not, in all likelihood, but... that magic was something else. Her control was a little wonky though.
She'd be extraordinarily powerful if she could master that. I wonder if there are many like her in the Devildom? That's kind of exciting, right, Hebiko? ...Hebiko?
As I looked next to me, Hebiko was about to doze off.
This temperature... is much too low... for an octopus to handle... zzz...
A-Are you going to hibernate on me!? You're gonna die!! Hey, wake up!!
I carried Hebiko, who was on the verge of belonging in the frozen seafood section, and headed through the snowstorm towards the station.
